sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Clivia miniata is an evergreen clump-forming perennial native to forest undergrowth and ravines in southern Africa. It grows to about 50 cm. Strap-shaped leaves arise from a fleshy underground base; in spring an umbel bears trumpet-shaped flowers, usually orange and sometimes yellow.

sections.title: Fruit and toxicity
sections.text: Red berries may develop after pollination. The plant is toxic if eaten, including to pets; its alkaloids include lycorine. The plate correctly shows the leaves, flower umbel and inset fruit.
